description: Make the whole worklog UI responsive from a 390px phone up to desktop, without changing how it looks at desktop widths. The user tested the work item peek on a phone: the totals labels clip ('Horas equivalent', 'Horas apontadas'), 'R$ 0,00' wraps inside its box, and the allowance title 'Bolsa de horas do chamado' collides with the '161% consumido' badge. The cause is fixed column counts and non-wrapping flex rows with no breakpoints. Every change is additive Tailwind responsive prefixing: the classes that apply at md and above must remain what they are today so the desktop layout is untouched.
steps: Study the fork's existing responsive convention before writing classes: apps/web/core/components/service-reports/consumption-tab.tsx, operational-tab.tsx and billing-tab.tsx all use `grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 rounded-lg border border-subtle p-4 md:grid-cols-4`. Mirror that shape (mobile-first base class, md: for the desktop count) rather than inventing a new one, and keep using the fork tokens (border-subtle, bg-surface-2, text-custom-text-350, etc.).

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-totals.tsx: replace the fixed `grid gap-2 ${cards.length === 4 ? 'grid-cols-4' : 'grid-cols-3'}` container with a responsive one - 2 columns on phones, the current 3 or 4 from md up. Give each card `min-w-0` so a grid item can actually shrink, let the label wrap instead of clipping (drop any nowrap, add `leading-tight`), and make the value survive a long string ('R$ 12.345,67', '1h 52min 30s') with `break-words` and a size step such as `text-sm md:text-base`. The Tooltip wrapper must stay the direct grid child so the columns still line up.

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-allowance-indicator.tsx: (a) the header row `flex items-center justify-between gap-2` must wrap on a phone so the consumed-percentage badge drops under the title instead of colliding with it - add wrapping and keep the title block `min-w-0` with a wrapping (not truncating) title, while the badge cluster stays `shrink-0`; (b) the figures container `grid grid-cols-3 gap-2` becomes responsive - the three labelled figures (creditado / consumido / restante) must each keep their label and value readable at 390px, so use fewer columns on mobile and restore `grid-cols-3` from sm or md up; (c) give the figure values `break-words` so '-2h 30min' and a long human duration do not overflow; (d) leave the progress bar and the alert boxes visually identical at desktop, but check the alert text block already wraps (it is `flex items-start gap-1.5` with an icon marked shrink-0 - confirm the span can wrap and add `min-w-0` if it cannot).

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-section.tsx: the section header is `flex items-center justify-between` and can hold four Buttons (Editar, Excluir, Bolsa de horas, Adicionar apontamento). Let the header wrap and let the action cluster wrap and align to the end, so on a phone the title takes one line and the buttons flow onto the next instead of squeezing. Do not remove or hide any button and do not change the permission conditions around them.

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-list-item.tsx: the entry row is `flex items-start justify-between gap-2` with a text column and a right-hand cluster of up to four badges plus the edit and delete icon buttons. Make the two blocks stack on a phone (or let the row wrap) with the action cluster still reachable and right-aligned at desktop, allow the badge cluster itself to wrap, and keep `min-w-0` on the text column. The per-segment line is already `flex flex-wrap` - verify the badges inside it (billing type, overridden hour type) do not force overflow, and that the description keeps `break-words whitespace-pre-wrap`.

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-client-section.tsx: the totals grid is already `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3`, so here the work is the cards and rows - add `min-w-0`/`break-words` to the card value, and make the row header (`flex items-center justify-between gap-2` holding the hours and the date) wrap or shrink so neither is cut. The metadata line is already `flex flex-wrap`; confirm it stays that way.

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-form.tsx: the interval pair (start_time / end_time, `flex gap-3`) and the catalogue dropdown pair (hour type / billing type, `flex gap-3`) must stack on a phone and stay side by side from sm up. Also check the entry-mode toggle (`flex w-fit`) and the footer button row still fit at 390px inside the modal.

apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-modal.tsx and the four other modals in the folder (credit-service-allowance-modal.tsx, edit-service-allowance-modal.tsx, delete-service-allowance-modal.tsx, delete-service-log-modal.tsx): confirm ModalCore's EModalWidth value behaves at 390px (read packages/ui's ModalCore implementation to see whether the width classes are already responsive) and reduce the inner `p-5` padding on mobile if the content is pinched. Only change what is actually cramped, and say in findings what you checked and left alone.

apps/web/core/components/issues/peek-overview/view.tsx: the side-peek/modal content wrapper is `relative flex flex-col gap-3 space-y-3 px-8 py-5`, spending 64px of a 390px viewport on horizontal padding. Make the horizontal padding responsive (small on phones, the current px-8 from md up) for both content branches. In the full-screen branch, the right rail is a hard `!w-[400px] flex-shrink-0` next to a scrolling column: make that layout stack (or the rail full width) below md while keeping the exact current desktop geometry. Touch nothing else in this file - it is a core Plane component shared by every work item.

apps/web/core/components/issues/issue-detail/main-content.tsx: check the container the ServiceLogSection sits in for a fixed width or a non-wrapping row that would clip the section on a phone, and apply the same additive responsive treatment if so. If it is already fine, say so in findings rather than changing it.

Re-read every file you touched and confirm no desktop-width class changed meaning: for each edit, the classes in effect at md and above must be the same set that was there before (a base class you added must be overridden at the breakpoint). List each file with its mobile / tablet / desktop behaviour in findings - this list is the summary the orchestrator has to hand back.

Run `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh lint <the paths you touched>` and `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types`, plus `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh i18n` if you touched any translation file (adding a shorter label is allowed only if you add the key to every locale under packages/i18n/src/locales/).
acceptance_criteria: No component under apps/web/core/components/service-logs/ contains a multi-column grid or a horizontal flex row of competing blocks without a responsive fallback: `grep -rn "grid-cols-" apps/web/core/components/service-logs` shows a mobile base class plus a sm:/md: override on every hit.

At a 390px viewport the reasoning holds for each of the four reported defects: totals cards sit two per row with wrapping labels, the monetary value has room for 'R$ 0,00' on one line, the allowance title and the consumed-percentage badge are on separate lines, and no text sits outside its bordered box.

The classes in effect from md up are unchanged for every file touched, so the desktop layout is byte-for-byte equivalent in rendered geometry (verifiable by diffing the class strings and confirming each addition is a mobile-only base with a md:/sm: restoration).
The peek side-peek/modal content padding is responsive and the full-screen right rail no longer forces a 400px column below md, with the desktop geometry of both preserved.
`./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types` passes and `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh lint` reports no warning on the touched paths (the pre-commit hook fails on any warning).
findings contains a per-file table of mobile / tablet / desktop behaviour.
